subject: High priority: Help/Concepts page and phase terminology
body:
High-priority task T-0156 is now assigned to you: Add Help/Concepts page and remove raw phase enums from user-facing UI.

Leader feedback: `SEALED_DIVERGENT` looks like an implementation leak. A user should never need to infer the protocol from an enum.

Scope:
1. Add a Help/Concepts route to main navigation, not a hidden page.
2. Explain the product philosophy: independent positions, the barrier, phase lifecycle, work items, conversations, approvals/refusals, and how a human acts on an item.
3. Include concrete examples and route links (Attention, Conversations, Work items, Audit & barrier, Plan).
4. Extract one shared phase-label helper; do not duplicate mappings.
5. All primary visible phase text must be human-readable. Keep raw protocol values only in tooltip/details/debug contexts.
6. Update header, Barrier tabs, descriptions, phase filter labels, phase history, and refusal rows.
7. Add tests for navigation, concepts content, human-readable labels, and absence of raw enum in visible text.

Acceptance is in the task record. Please confirm receipt and keep this in the current dashboard batch.
